title: Adobe (ADBE) and Alibaba (BABA) Deep Dive Analysis
summary: Inflation thresholds and two growth selections.
coverage_note: All numbered text blocks and image labels read. Material theses, forecasts and explanations are included; routine holdings lists, incidental statistics, company descriptions and boilerplate are excluded. Chart pixels were not inspected.

claims.reason: Payrolls eventually regained their pre-pandemic level in July 2022, consistent with a gradual recovery rather than an immediate reopening restoration. This supports timing direction, not an exact monthly path.
claims.mechanism_assessment: Outcome evidence does not independently identify causation.

evidence.title: July 2022 Employment Situation release
evidence.finding: The release reported payroll employment and unemployment rate had returned to February 2020 levels in July 2022. This is a publication-vintage recovery date, not a claim about subsequently revised payroll history.

claims.reason: Reopening progressed, but later variants materially reduced vaccine protection. Many things feeling normal is qualitative and the disease-risk description needs age and endpoint distinctions.
claims.timing_assessment: Original horizon retained: late summer or autumn 2021
claims.mechanism_assessment: Outcome evidence does not independently identify causation.

evidence.title: Vaccine safety and effectiveness statement
evidence.finding: Omicron emergence reduced protection; booster doses were needed to restore and maintain protection, while three doses retained robust protection against severe outcomes in non-immunocompromised people.

claims.reason: March income rose 21.1%, with transfer payments driving the increase. The mechanism and timing are directly supported.
claims.mechanism_assessment: Outcome evidence does not independently identify causation.

evidence.title: March 2021 personal income
evidence.finding: Personal income increased 21.1% in March 2021, driven by government social benefits including the additional economic impact payments; consumption rose 4.2%.

claims.reason: A broad plan was announced in 2022 but blocked and struck down in 2023. Announcement was not implementation. Targeted discharges under other programs do not fulfill the stated broad $10,000 cancellation scenario.

claims.mechanism_assessment: Outcome evidence does not independently identify causation.

evidence.title: Biden v. Nebraska
evidence.finding: Court held the HEROES Act did not authorize the broad student-loan cancellation program announced in 2022. The proposed $10,000/$20,000 relief did not take effect under that program.

claims.reason: The direction of strong nominal growth was realized: BEA initially reported 10.0% calendar-year nominal GDP growth in 2021. evidence.title: GDP fourth quarter and year 2021, advance estimate
evidence.finding: Current-dollar GDP increased 10.0% in calendar 2021 to $22.99 trillion in the advance estimate. This is a dated release vintage, not the latest revised series.

claims.reason: April annual CPI rose 4.2%. A low comparison base mechanically raises year-over-year growth for a given current level, although actual monthly inflation also accelerated.
claims.mechanism_assessment: Outcome evidence does not independently identify causation.

evidence.title: April 2021 CPI
evidence.finding: Headline CPI rose 4.2% year over year in April 2021, exceeding the article forecast threshold above 3%.

claims.reason: Inflation persisted beyond base effects. Additional fiscal support, reopening and supply constraints coincided, so persistence does not identify which conditional channel was decisive.

evidence.title: June 2022 Consumer Price Index
evidence.finding: June 2022 headline CPI rose 9.1% over twelve months.

evidence.title: About the American Rescue Plan
evidence.finding: ARP passed Congress March 10, 2021 and was signed March 11. Treasury managed over $1 trillion in its programs and tax credits, confirming further large fiscal support after 2020.

claims.claim: Bond market may reject low yields
claims.reason: The rhetorical concern about sub-2% yields did not describe late-spring outcomes: ten-year yields were 1.58% in late May and 1.24% by July. The text explicitly expressed uncertainty, so this is a weak scenario warning rather than a failed precise rate target.
claims.timing_assessment: Original horizon retained: next few months
claims.mechanism_assessment: Outcome evidence does not independently identify causation.

evidence.title: Ten-year nominal Treasury yields
evidence.finding: March 15, 2021 1.62%; May 28 1.58%; July 30 1.24%. Yields remained below 2% despite spring inflation acceleration.

claims.reason: Discounting predicts lower present value for a fixed cash-flow path when required returns rise. Actual growth and risk premiums also move, so nominal Treasury yields alone cannot settle a stock-return forecast.
claims.mechanism_assessment: Outcome evidence does not independently identify causation.

claims.reason: The article initially uses forward inflation compensation but later discusses realized inflation as though interchangeable. Ten-year TIPS yield and nominal yield minus current CPI are different measures, so a CPI surprise does not mechanically change the plotted real yield.
claims.mechanism_assessment: Outcome evidence does not independently identify causation.

evidence.title: Ten-year real Treasury yield
evidence.finding: Ten-year TIPS yield reached -1.19% on August 3, 2021, below the cited -1.08% threshold. January 19 -1.00%; March 31 -0.63%.

evidence.title: Ten-year nominal Treasury yields
evidence.finding: March 15, 2021 1.62%; May 28 1.58%; July 30 1.24%. Yields remained below 2% despite spring inflation acceleration.

claims.reason: The expiry occurred, but its effect on purchases requires bank-level capital and securities data. A leverage constraint is not an absolute cap, and Treasury market absorption can shift to other buyers.

claims.claim: Dollar leans weaker over six months
claims.reason: The broad dollar basket declined only 0.16% over the six-month check, essentially flat. This fits the low-conviction neutral-to-bearish framing but is weak evidence for a meaningful currency advantage.

evidence.finding: March 15, 2021 113.1928; September 14 113.0061, down 0.16%. Broad trade-weighted basket rather than DXY.

claims.claim: Bitcoin makes new highs this year
claims.reason: The November daily peak exceeded the March $61,000 reference. This specific new-high forecast succeeded even though a buy-and-hold position from March could finish the year lower.

claims.claim: China restrains rather than cripples Alibaba
claims.reason: The company continued operating, but cloud growth slowed sharply on the recast FY 2022-24 series and shareholders suffered substantial losses. Regulatory survival is a much lower bar than the favorable investment outcome implied.
claims.mechanism_assessment: Outcome evidence does not independently identify causation.

claims.claim: Adobe may offer lower spring entry
claims.reason: Adobe traded as low as $437.77 on March 15, below the article approximate $444 reference, but never reached the proposed $415 put strike before standard June expiry. A modest lower entry occurred; treating the strike as a promised price target would overstate the claim.
claims.timing_assessment: Original horizon retained: spring; June option
claims.mechanism_assessment: Outcome evidence does not independently identify causation.

evidence.title: Adobe spring 2021 daily OHLC
evidence.finding: From March 15 through June 18, 2021, the lowest daily intraday low was $437.77 on March 15, above the proposed $415 put strike. Exact June expiration was not supplied.

claims.reason: The payoff arithmetic is broadly correct if the quoted premium was executable. Crossing the strike does not force early assignment; the holder chooses exercise. Annualizing one three-month premium does not promise repeatable annual returns, and downside below breakeven remains stock-like.
claims.mechanism_assessment: Business performance and shareholder return are distinct.

evidence.title: Options assignment FAQ
evidence.finding: American-style exercise is the holder's decision before expiration. At expiration, exercise-by-exception thresholds and contrary instructions apply; going in the money does not itself compel early assignment.

framework_lessons: Business growth can coexist with poor shareholder returns.
assessment: The spring inflation threshold and Bitcoin new-high call were successful. Broad student forgiveness failed to be implemented, and the explicit multi-year Adobe and Alibaba investment cases performed poorly. Their disclosed valuation and political risks deserve weight in the outcome.
verification_limitations: Retrieved 2026-11-07; publication-date wording is not authenticated.

Public market series are available, but not every investment claim has a defined horizon or reconciled corporate-action-adjusted return. Unverified outcomes remain unscored; macro data use latest available vintages.
